Who it's for

Built for Every Level of Aviation Education

From secondary school aviation programs to flight colleges and workforce development boards — AACP™ scales to your institution's needs.

🏫

School Boards & Secondary Schools

Introduce aviation careers to students early. Integrate AACP™ into career education programs, co-op placements, and skilled trades pathways.

🎓

Support aviation program students with pathway clarity, scholarship discovery, and AI-guided career mentorship — integrated into your student services.

✈️

Platform Features

Everything Your Institution Needs

🎓

Bulk Student Access

Provision full Premium Student access for your entire cohort under a single institutional agreement. No per-student billing friction — students sign up with your institution code.

  • Cohort-based access provisioning
  • Simple student onboarding with institution code
  • Unlimited ACIA™ career chat for all enrolled students
  • Full pathway maps, education directory & scholarship finder
📚

Educator & Counsellor Resources

Equip your teachers and career counsellors with the same tools your students use — plus curriculum alignment notes, career pathway summaries, and class activity guides.

  • Educator-specific access tier
  • Curriculum alignment resources
  • Career exploration activity guides
  • OSCA workshop integration support
📊

Privacy-Protected Reporting

Understand how your students are engaging with aviation careers without compromising their privacy. Aggregate analytics show pathway interest trends, scholarship engagement, and program reach.

  • Aggregate engagement dashboards (no individual tracking)
  • PIPEDA-aligned data handling
  • Pathway popularity reports by cohort
  • Export-ready summary reports for program leads
🤝

Partnership & Integration Support

AACP™ works alongside your existing student information systems and career development frameworks. Our team supports custom onboarding, LMS integration planning, and co-branded experiences.

  • Custom institution co-branding options
  • LMS integration consultation
  • Dedicated onboarding support
  • Partnership inquiry pathway for industry bodies
